 ROLL CALL

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  26-54897  Recommend to the Government Operations and Efficiency Committee to rename
  Los Altos Plaza Park to Park Estates Community Park. (District 4)

 PUBLIC COMMENT

 Opportunity to address the Parks and Recreation Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker
 is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

 ADJOURNMENT

 I, Christine Amaya, Administrative Aide, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 24 hours
 prior to the meeting.

 NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
 https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
 Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Parks, Recreation and Marine Administration
 Office at (562) 570-3170.

PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION MINUTES

  2800 N. STUDEBAKER ROAD
  DR. THOMAS J. CLARK COMMUNITY CENTER
  BRIDGE ROOM, 10:00 AM

Susan Redfield, Chair  Sharleen Higa, Commissioner
Silissa Uriarte Smith, Vice Chair  Robert Livingstone, Commissioner
Cory Allen, Commissioner  Kasey Schoen, Commissioner
Christopher Chavez, Commissioner

Stephen Scott, Director
Jennifer Roberts, Executive Assistant

  FINISHED AGENDA & DRAFT MINUTES

  SPECIAL MEETING

 CALL TO ORDER

 At 10:19 AM, Chair Redfield called the meeting to order.

 ROLL CALL

 Commissioners Present: Allen, Chavez, Livingstone, Uriarte Smith, Redfield

 Commissioners Absent: Higa, Schoen

 Also present: Stephen Scott, Director of Parks, Recreation and Marine, Eric Woodson, Bureau
 Manager, Janiece McMullin, Acting Bureau Manager, Caitlynn Cruz, Recreation Superintendent,
 Sherlyn Beatty, Park Partnerships Officer, Christine Amaya, Administrative Aide.

 Commissioner Schoen and Commissioner Higa are excused from this meeting.

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  26-54897  Recommend to the Government Operations and Efficiency Committee to rename
  Los Altos Plaza Park to Park Estates Community Park. (District 4)

  A motion was made by Commissioner Livingstone, seconded by
  Commissioner Allen, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by
  the following vote:

  Yes:  5  Allen, Chavez, Livingstone, Uriarte Smith, Redfield
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 2  Higa, Schoen

At 10:26 AM, there being no objection, Chair Redfield declared the meeting adjourned.
